adapter_contract.units: acceleration in g; gyroscope in rad/s
adapter_contract.clock_policy: preserve native timestamps and rates; split hard clock gaps; do not interpolate
adapter_contract.missing_data_policy: retain an explicit boolean validity mask; do not invent measurements

acquisition_gate.selection_rule: Retain a source only when it adds a distinct annotation or deployment condition.

openpack.name: OpenPack
openpack.distinct_value: Nested fine-action, operation, and box-cycle intervals in continuous occupational work.
openpack.sensors: Four nominal-30 Hz IMUs on both wrists and upper arms; acceleration, gyroscope, and quaternion. Released timestamps measure 30.30-33.33 Hz and must be preserved.
openpack.annotations: The inspected release contains 53,760 fine-action and 20,264 operation rows, NULL, box cycles, orders, and outliers; the paper reports 52,529 and 20,129.
openpack.format: One ZIP per released subject identifier containing timestamped CSV/JSON streams.
openpack.download_scope: All 21 non-RGB subject archives; do not download RGB or the redundant preprocessed operation-only archive.
openpack.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for the non-RGB release

crossfit.name: CrossFit exercise repetitions
crossfit.distinct_value: Large subject-diverse collection with externally cued repetition starts for complex full-body exercises.
crossfit.sensors: Wrist and ankle smartwatches at approximately 100 Hz; acceleration, gyroscope, and orientation.
crossfit.annotations: Ten exercises, 446 released non-NULL exercise arrays, and 5,461 non-NULL repetition arrays. Six repetition fragments are under 0.2 seconds and must be excluded or separately justified.
crossfit.format: NumPy arrays shaped channels by time; 18 rows combine wrist and ankle acceleration, gyroscope, and orientation.
crossfit.download_scope: Authored code and constrained/unconstrained sensor data; exclude pretrained models.
crossfit.license: No explicit machine-readable licence found; non-commercial research use must be confirmed before publication.

aidlab_har.name: AIDLAB-HAR
aidlab_har.distinct_value: Small source with precise series boundaries and repetition-marker fiducials for checking event proposals.
aidlab_har.sensors: Chest 50 Hz acceleration and orientation; no released raw gyroscope.
aidlab_har.annotations: Thirteen exercises, three background activities, series intervals, and repetition-marker fiducial windows; the marker windows are not complete repetitions.
aidlab_har.format: EDF signals plus CSV event annotations.

c_mhad.name: C-MHAD
c_mhad.distinct_value: Video-verified actions embedded in real continuous background with wrist and waist conditions.
c_mhad.sensors: 50 Hz six-axis Shimmer3 IMU; wrist gestures and waist transitions.
c_mhad.annotations: 240 two-minute streams with manually inspected action start/end times.
c_mhad.format: CSV with two metadata rows plus one XLSX annotation workbook per subject/application.
c_mhad.download_scope: Download inertial CSV and annotation workbooks only; exclude all AVI video and duplicate XLS files.
c_mhad.license: Publicly released for research; no machine-readable licence found.

wear.name: WEAR
wear.distinct_value: Natural outdoor continuous activity and NULL from consumer-like limb watches.
wear.sensors: Four 50 Hz gravity-present accelerometers on both wrists and ankles.
wear.annotations: Eighteen activities, NULL, and THUMOS-style intervals.
wear.format: Subject CSV files with fixed-rate rows plus JSON interval annotations.
wear.download_scope: Download 50 Hz inertial CSV and 60 fps interval JSON only; exclude camera and precomputed feature payloads.

oca.name: Overhead Car Assembly IMU Dataset
oca.distinct_value: Repeated industrial assembly phases, NULL, official subject splits, and arm-support conditions.
oca.sensors: Four BNO055 six-axis IMU streams on upper arms and vest/chest at native rates near 20 or 27 Hz; acceleration is m/s2 and gyroscope is degree/s.
oca.annotations: Six work phases, NULL, approximately 282 assembly cycles, and official splits.
oca.format: Twelve timestamped CSV sessions, README, and metadata JSON in one ZIP.
oca.adapter_requirements: Preserve timestamps, split P0-R0 at its 81-second clock gap, divide acceleration by 9.80665, and multiply gyroscope by pi/180.
oca.download_scope: Complete archive; no video is included.

bodyweight.name: Bodyweight Exercise Segmentation
bodyweight.reason: Acceleration and gyroscope integer scaling is not documented well enough for defensible physical conversion.
bodyweight.format: Continuous JSON plus segment and repetition CSV metadata.

recofit.name: RecoFit
recofit.distinct_value: More than 200 participants, full visits, natural non-exercise background, and set/count annotations add population and background diversity.
recofit.repository_subjects: over 200 across the two release files
recofit.sensors: Arm-worn 50 Hz acceleration in g and gyroscope in degree/s.
recofit.annotations: Exercise-set intervals, total repetition counts, exercise labels, and natural visit background; no per-repetition intervals.
recofit.format: MATLAB structure with visits, sensor streams, set intervals, counts, and background.
recofit.download_scope: Download the continuous multi-exercise visit file only; exclude the duplicate isolated-exercise file.
recofit.license: Community Data License Agreement - Permissive, Version 2.0

cara.name: CaRa
cara.reason: Sequence counts duplicate the stronger CrossFit supervision and the repository lacks a clear licence.

dwc.name: DWC/ExRAC
dwc.reason: The 8.81 GiB archive exceeds the normal gate and localizes only the first three repetitions of each sequence.

simul.name: SIMUL
simul.reason: The 2.39 GiB checkout is almost entirely gait/steps and duplicates narrower conditions already available without improving the core task matrix.
simul.format: Timestamped CSV with six synchronized IMUs and exact step files.

reuse_existing_without_copy.monipar: Primary Task-2 longitudinal source and Task-1 cross-week evaluation.
reuse_existing_without_copy.mmfit: Reconstruct full workouts for development; set intervals and counts are weaker than exact repetition boundaries.
reuse_existing_without_copy.harmes: Fifth training/development source; reconstruct event gaps for wrist-ADL development.
reuse_existing_without_copy.opportunity: Reconstruct full runs and fine gesture annotations for development only.
reuse_existing_without_copy.capture24: Use only as natural background and scale stress data, not as event-boundary truth.
reuse_existing_without_copy.phytmo: Task-2 controlled correct/incorrect development only because HALO pretraining consumed it.
reuse_existing_without_copy.kneepad: Conditional Task-2 known-difference source; trials are short and placements are research-grade.
reuse_existing_without_copy.spar: Within-bout repeatability development; repetitions within one bout are not independent sessions.
